title: Azusawa Kohane — I'll Protect You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ...and the night festival was really fun because I got to watch my friend's band play alongside my classmates!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
It sounds like the School Festival turned out to be quite an event.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still... Not being able to take that wolf's head off must've been terrible. I'm glad you didn't get hurt during all that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too. I was fine in the end...
But I sort of caused a lot of people a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That wasn't your fault, Kohane!
It was my fault for getting scared and running away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Guh... Hey...
You could try to cheer me up a little, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, what you said is actually true. Why do I need to say otherwise?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm so sorry, An. I really didn't mean to scare you like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also need to apologize to you too, Shinonome, Aoyagi. I'm sorry for leaving you two behind that time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. We honestly didn't have any idea what was going on then, so there was no way either of us could've stopped either of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito even said how he probably would've been able to help a little if you didn't look like a dog...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A-Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we can't change what happened. So, it's fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what did you two do while Kohane chased after An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's a good question...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We started looking for you two since neither of you would pick up your phones.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right... You guys did call us a bunch of times...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sorry. I really had no idea...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You didn't notice even when Rin was there with you? You must've been desperate to find An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, even if you did pick up, you probably weren't in a state to hold an intelligible conversation...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we wandered around your school looking for the two of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was when we ran into Momoi and Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We found them in the courtyard advertising what their class was doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After speaking to them, we decided to have some of what they were offering.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what did they make...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Lookalike sweets.
Minori, Shiho and I went over on the first day and tried a lot of different things.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Lookalike sweets...?
That sounds interesting. Care to explain further?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They had some that looked like sushi but it was really chocolate. There was also a steak that was actually bread.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They also had pot sticker cookies too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I felt so confused while eating them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My eyes saw a pot sticker, but my tongue was telling me that it was a cookie.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can see why your brain would've been so confused.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I'm really glad that you were both able to enjoy the festival together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. After that, we wandered around searching for Azusawa and Shiraishi while soaking in the atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we had another look around after meeting back up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?!
So we didn't need to feel that sorry after all?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Didn't I say not to worry?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
By the way, did you take any pictures?
I'd like to see what it was like if possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane took tons.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I did!
Where would you like to start?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well... Why don't we start with what this zombie wolf An ran from looked like?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to see just how scary it was.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
B-Brace yourself, MEIKO!
It's super duper scary!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
